caption: 01 · STABILIZE — What cannot wait?. Secure people, payroll, orders, client commitments, facilities, insurance, accounts, credentials, physical objects, master files, and communications. Do not make permanent symbolic decisions inside the first emergency response.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what cannot wait? within What Happens to a House After the Founder?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · LOCATE — Where does authority reside?. Map board and officer authority, ownership, employment, IP, licenses, estate or probate instruments, archive agreements, and operational delegations by jurisdiction and record.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping where does authority reside? within What Happens to a House After the Founder?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · INTERPRET — What should continue—and why?. Separate non-negotiable values, teachable method, recurring codes, historical accidents, commercial habits, and motifs. Preserve the decision logic, not a taxidermy of the last collection.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what should continue—and why? within What Happens to a House After the Founder?.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · ACCOUNT — Who may test the next chapter?. Define successor scope, review bodies, worker and collaborator credit, community consultation, archive citation, performance measures, correction, and removal or renewal.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
